theater: 蘇美爾南部古埃丁平原與埃蘭邊境

battle.name: 恩納圖姆的行動
battle.theater: 蘇美爾南部古埃丁平原與埃蘭邊境
battle.brief: 公元前二五〇〇年前後，拉伽什王恩納圖姆在古埃丁平原上打贏對烏瑪的戰爭，又東征埃蘭、攻入蘇薩，把烏爾與尼普爾重收旗下。御前銘文寫他手持束柄銅矛，在披甲步兵方陣之前督戰，四輪戰車與矛兵方陣才是取勝主力；本卡那件早王朝的埃及長矛，正是同型的束柄銅矛。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是美索不達米亞南部的拉伽什城邦，與它西北面的烏瑪城邦；戰局之後延伸到伊朗高原西緣的埃蘭。拉伽什此時是蘇美爾第三王朝的所在，統治者稱恩西，既是城邦的君長，也是寧吉爾蘇與娜娜諸神廟的實際主持；恩納圖姆是第三代君主，祖父烏爾南什開國，父阿庫爾伽爾承位。拉伽什的武裝以城邦常備的大軍為主體，配以市區集結的兵員與城外的莊戶民兵，歸恩西直接調度，糧秣靠神廟庫房供應，銅料則由東面的埃蘭與南面的迪爾蒙船運輸入。烏瑪在拉伽什西北，隔著古埃丁平原與它相望，國君亦稱恩西；烏什在位時烏瑪實力足以與拉伽什爭奪那片產糧地，其後由埃納卡列接位，兩家因界渠與田界糾紛不斷。埃蘭是高原西緣的強國，首都蘇薩，扼住通往波斯灣的商路與銅料來源，是拉伽什最想擄掠的方向。蘇美爾其他城邦——烏爾、尼普爾、烏魯克、阿克沙克、基什——在這場戰爭裡多數不是獨立的交戰方，而是被捲入的附庸或徵發來源：烏魯克的恩沙庫什安納名列蘇美爾王表，基什是恩納圖姆攫取的古老王號，馬里更遠在西北敘利亞方向，只在銘文裡被寫成進貢的終點。
countriesEn: The two sides in the field were the city-state of Lagash in southern Mesopotamia and the city-state of Umma to its north-west; the campaign then extended east to Elam on the western edge of the Iranian plateau. Lagash at this time was the seat of the Third Dynasty of Sumer, and its ruler bore the title of ensi, acting both as the lord of the city-state and as the practical head of the temples of Ningirsu and Nanshe; Eannatum was the third ruler of that line, his grandfather Ur-Nanshe having founded it and his father Akurgal succeeding him. The armed force of Lagash consisted mainly of the city's standing great army, supported by troops mustered inside the town and by peasant levies from the countryside, all under the ensi's direct command; grain came out of the temple stores, and the copper that supplied the weapon trade arrived from Elam in the east and by ship from Dilmun in the south. Umma lay north-west of Lagash, facing it across the plain of Gu-Edin, and its ruler also bore the title of ensi; in the time of Ush Umma was strong enough to dispute that grain-growing plain with Lagash, and he was succeeded by Enakalle, with the two cities endlessly in dispute over boundary canals and field lines. Elam was a major power on the western edge of the highland, its capital at Susa, holding the trade routes and the copper sources that led to the Persian Gulf, and it was the direction Lagash most wanted to strip. The other Sumerian cities — Ur, Nippur, Uruk, Akshak, Kish — were for the most part not independent belligerents in this war but absorbed dependents and sources of levies: Enshakushanna of Uruk appears on the Sumerian King List, Kish was the ancient royal title Eannatum seized upon, and Mari, far away to the north-west in Syria, appears in the inscriptions only as the far end of the tribute route.
people: 關鍵人物是拉伽什王恩納圖姆本人。他的蘇美爾名以「安納圖姆」為核心，銘文寫成受英利爾與娜娜護佑的君王；拉伽什出土的一塊巨石銘文還記下他另一個阿摩利特語的名字，稱盧瑪，說明這位城邦君長自帶阿摩利特成分的統治傳統。他執政約在公元前二四五〇年前後，祖父烏爾南什開創拉伽什第三王朝，父阿庫爾伽爾曾率城邦聯盟南征、攻滅烏爾城邦，恩納圖姆接過的已是一個成型的帝國雛形。對手一方的核心人物是烏瑪君長烏什：拉伽什的御前銘文說他從寧吉爾蘇的安塔蘇拉一路打到阿克沙克，把祖祖擊敗；碑上殘文也記烏瑪方面陣亡者達三千六百，屍體堆積直達天際，而烏什其後在烏瑪城內被自己人反對而死。烏什死後埃納卡列接掌烏瑪，與恩納圖姆立下界約；其子恩梅特納接位後再度用兵，把戰爭推至最高潮，他留下的圓錐形銘文自誇戰果，並把洪水淹掉烏瑪郊區說成神蹟。戰役的另一位主角是神：禿鷹碑把武神尼努爾塔畫成手持巨網、罩住一整群烏瑪俘虜的樣子，等於宣告這場勝利出自主神護佑；碑文同時提到英利爾、娜娜與寧吉爾蘇，說恩納圖姆是寧吉爾蘇親口賜名、由娜娜選中的人。
peopleEn: The decisive figure is Eannatum, ruler of Lagash. His Sumerian name is built on the element Anatum, and the inscriptions present him as a king favoured by Enlil and Nanshe; a boulder inscription recovered at Lagash also records a second, Amorite name for him, Lumma, which shows that this city lord carried an Amorite element in his own ruling tradition. He reigned at about 2450 BC. His grandfather Ur-Nanshe had founded the Third Dynasty of Lagash, and his father Akurgal had led a coalition of cities south to destroy the city-state of Ur, so Eannatum inherited an already forming empire. The central figure on the other side was Ush, ruler of Umma: the Lagash royal inscriptions say he was driven from the Antasurra of Ningirsu all the way to Akshak and that Zuzu was beaten, and the fragmentary text on the stele puts the Ummaites' dead at three thousand six hundred, their corpses reaching the base of heaven; Ush himself was later killed by his own people in a rising inside Umma. After Ush died, Enakalle took over Umma and concluded a boundary agreement with Eannatum; Enakalle's son Enmetena, succeeding him, took up arms again and drove the war to its height, and the cone-shaped inscription he left boasts of his results and presents the flood that drowned the countryside of Umma as a divine marvel. The other principal actor in the war is the god: the Stele of the Vultures shows the war god Ninurta holding a great net in which a whole mass of Ummaites are caught, which is to say that the victory was declared to have come under the protection of the deity. The text of the stele names Enlil, Nanshe and Ningirsu, and says that Eannatum was named by Ningirsu himself and chosen by Nanshe in her heart.
kits: 本卡那件早王朝的埃及長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上，在埃及是守城垣與收復失地的標準刺器；放到恩納圖姆的戰場上，它是「第一代金屬刺擊兵器」這個技術家族的代表，而非蘇美爾軍隊實際配發的裝備。蘇美爾方面同期真正列裝的，是束柄銅矛與銅斧，配合以木為骨、蒙皮或包銅的盾牌，戴皮盔或銅盔；弓手與投石手在兩翼游走，密集的矛兵方陣才是正面決勝的骨幹。恩納圖姆本人按禿鷹碑的形象，右手揮的是一件由三條金屬條用箍環捆綁而成的錘形兵器，身披短裙、戴盔的近衛在車後列隊前進。載具方面，此時的美索不達米亞還沒有馬匹，戰車是四輪、由野驢牽引的車，蘇美爾人自己稱之為四輪車；它既是指揮平台，也是撞擊與追擊的衝鋒手段。攻城沒有大型器械，也沒有任何火器，靠的是泥磚城牆、壕溝、截斷界渠與圍城斷糧。押運與補給靠底格里斯河與幼發拉底河的船隻，以及迪爾蒙方向運來的木材與銅料；恩納圖姆在位時於尼娜城挖渠蓄水、為寧吉爾蘇砌以燒磚砌成的水井，正是把戰爭的續航能力寫在水利上。
kitsEn: The card's early dynastic Egyptian spear, a copper or bronze blade bound to a wooden shaft, was in Egypt the standard thrusting weapon for holding city walls and for reconquering lost ground; set in Eannatum's battlefield it stands for the family of first-generation metal thrusting weapons rather than for an item actually issued to the Sumerian troops. What the Sumerians really carried at this time were socketed copper spears and copper axes, with shields of wood overlaid with hide or sheet copper, and helmets of leather or copper; archers and slingers worked along the flanks, and the dense spear phalanx was the backbone of a decision in the open field. Eannatum himself, as he appears on the Stele of the Vultures, swings in his right hand a mace-like weapon made of three metal bars bound together by rings, while his helmeted attendants in kilts march on behind his wagon. As for draught animals, there were still no horses in Mesopotamia at this date: the war wagon had four wheels and was pulled by onagers, and the Sumerians called it the four-wheeler. It served both as a platform for command and as the shock arm for charging and pursuit. Siege work knew no heavy machines and no firearms at all; it relied on mud-brick city walls, ditches, cutting the boundary canals and starving the city out by blockade. Movement and supply ran on boats on the Tigris and Euphrates and on timber and copper arriving from Dilmun; and in Eannatum's reign the city of Nina was rebuilt with canals and reservoirs, and a well of fired brick was built for Ningirsu, which is to say that the staying power of the war was written into the waterworks.
tactics: 兩家的打法都未脫離城邦時代的框架，但拉伽什已把它推到極致。對烏瑪的方向，重心是古埃丁平原的田界與界渠：恩納圖姆親自率大軍出城，在平原上列密集的矛兵方陣，披甲持盾的步兵緊貼成前後數排，以盾與矛頭頂住烏瑪的進攻，恩納圖姆站在方陣之前督陣，必要時登上四輪車突入戰線。戰車部隊負責衝擊、追擊與遮蔽步兵翼側；弓手與投石手在陣後與兩翼射擊，壓制敵方隊形；攻城戰則以圍城、斷糧與截斷界渠為主，逼烏瑪求和。往埃蘭方向，行動轉為長距離野戰遠征：隊伍沿幼發拉底河與迪爾蒙方向的商路推進，奪取阿茲、掃擊舒布爾、直抵蘇薩；銘文把這一串戰果排成一列，說恩納圖姆征服了埃蘭之地、征服烏魯阿、征服烏瑪、征服烏爾。往北，他再打阿克沙克與基什，把勢力伸到馬里。整套動作的骨架是「以平原會戰定邊界、以遠征立聲望、以水利固後方」；正因如此，烏瑪的崩潰不只出在戰場上，恩梅特納的圓錐銘文把洪水淹掉烏瑪郊區寫成大勝，說明兵事、水災與界約三者被編在一起，用來替城邦政治服務。
tacticsEn: Neither side had shaken off the framework of the city-state, but Lagash pushed that framework to its limit. On the Umma axis the centre of gravity was the field boundaries and the boundary canals of the plain of Gu-Edin: Eannatum led the great army out of the city in person, formed a dense spear phalanx on the plain, and pressed the armoured shield-bearers into several ranks one behind another so that shields and spearheads would hold off the Umma advance, with the king himself standing before the phalanx to direct it and, when needed, riding his four-wheeled wagon into the line. The wagon troops were responsible for charging, pursuit and covering the flanks of the infantry; archers and slingers shot from the rear and the wings to break up the enemy order; and in the sieges the method was encirclement, cutting the grain and severing the boundary canal until Umma sued for terms. Eastward the operation turned into a long open-country expedition: the column advanced along the Euphrates and the trade road toward Dilmun, took Az, struck Shubur, and came as far as Susa. The inscription lists these results in a row, saying that Eannatum conquered the land of Elam, conquered Urua, conquered Umma, conquered Ur. Northward he struck again at Akshak and Kish and stretched his reach as far as Mari. The skeleton of the whole operation is: a set-piece battle on the plain to fix the frontier, a distant expedition to build prestige, and waterworks to secure the rear. That is also why the collapse of Umma did not come only on the field: Enmetena's cone inscription presents the flood that drowned the Umma countryside as a great victory, showing how battle, flood and treaty-boundary were woven together to serve the politics of the city-state.
data: 日期是這一戰最不確定的一項。拉伽什第三王朝的開國王烏爾南什在位約二十四年，通常排在前二五一八至前二五一四年；恩納圖姆則通常排在前二四五〇年前後，本站這張卡沿用戰爭列表的整數年份前二五〇〇年，出兵月份記為四月，即洪水退去、河水回落、可以動員車兵與步卒的開戰季節，但史料並沒有留下出兵的具體月日。距離可以用地望推：拉伽什的司法與行政中心基爾蘇（今泰洛）在北緯三十一度二十五分、東經四十六度二十四分，烏瑪（今泰勒焦哈）在北緯三十一度、東經四十五度三十四分，兩城相距約六十公里，中間就是那一片古埃丁平原；往東，蘇薩在北緯三十二度十一分、東經四十八度十六分，與基爾蘇的直線距離約二百公里，遠征隊伍的實際路程當然遠多於此。尺度方面，禿鷹碑為石灰岩，復原高約一點八公尺、寬約一點三公尺，一八八一年在泰洛出土，今藏羅浮宮，約立於前二四五〇年；碑上殘文以三千六百記烏瑪方面的陣亡者，說屍體堆積直達天底，並記烏什死於本國的叛亂。治水方面，恩納圖姆在位時重修尼娜城（今泰勒祖爾古勒），開渠蓄水，並為寧吉爾蘇砌燒磚水井；拉伽什與烏瑪之間那道被後世銘文反覆提及的大牆，也是他這一時期留下的工事。
dataEn: The date is the least certain element of this war. Ur-Nanshe, the founder of the Third Dynasty of Lagash, ruled for about twenty-four years and is usually placed at 2518 to 2514 BC; Eannatum is usually placed at about 2450 BC. This card follows the round year 2500 BC used in the list of wars, and the month of April is given as the start of the campaign season, the time when the flood had receded, the rivers had fallen, and wagons and infantry could be moved, but the sources preserve no specific day of departure. Distances can be derived from the sites: the judicial and administrative centre of Lagash, Girsu (modern Telloh), lies at 31°25′ north and 46°24′ east, Umma (modern Tell Jokha) at 31° north and 45°34′ east, so the two cities stand about sixty kilometres apart with the plain of Gu-Edin between them; eastward, Susa at 32°11′ north and 48°16′ east is about two hundred kilometres from Girsu in a straight line, and the marching column of the expedition covered a good deal more. On measurements, the Stele of the Vultures is of limestone, about 1.8 metres high and 1.3 metres wide once restored, was found at Telloh in 1881 and is now in the Louvre, and was set up about 2450 BC; its fragmentary text puts the Ummaites' dead at three thousand six hundred, saying that the corpses reached the base of heaven, and records that Ush was killed in a rising inside his own city. On works: in Eannatum's reign the city of Nina (modern Tell Zurghul) was rebuilt with canals and reservoirs, and a well of fired brick was built for Ningirsu; the great wall between Lagash and Umma, mentioned again and again in later inscriptions, also belongs to this period of his work.
cause: 打起來的理由有三層。眼前是古埃丁平原的爭奪：這片介於拉伽什與烏瑪之間的沃土是兩城的糧倉，界渠、田界與灌溉水的分配年年糾紛；烏什在位時烏瑪強盛，屢次越界奪田，兩座城邑又近在六十公里之內，一次田界仲裁失手就會變成全面開戰。深一層是外來成分的壓力：迪爾蒙的船運、北方草原的遊牧者、以及城邦內部阿摩利特成分的上升，一直在削弱蘇美爾城邦的經濟基礎；恩納圖姆把戰爭說成安納圖姆之名，又以阿摩利特名盧瑪留名，正是要證明拉伽什扛得住這些壓力。最後是名號：基什的古老王權在早王朝後期空懸，銘文說女神伊南娜把基什的王權一併賜給恩納圖姆，恩納圖姆因此自稱基什之王。對拉伽什來說，爭取基什王號、讓烏爾與尼普爾重新承認拉伽什的宗主地位，是一場以戰爭換取政治合法性的行動；碑上那套神話場面，正是這層打算的官方說法。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason behind the fighting. The immediate one was the struggle over the plain of Gu-Edin: that stretch of fertile ground between Lagash and Umma was the granary of both cities, and the division of boundary canals, field lines and irrigation water was a standing quarrel; with Umma strong under Ush, its people repeatedly took fields beyond the line, and with the two cities barely sixty kilometres apart a single failed arbitration over a field line was enough to turn into general war. A deeper layer was the pressure from outside: shipping from Dilmun, the herders of the northern steppes, and the rising share of Amorite elements inside the cities were all eating away at the economic base of the Sumerian city-states. That Eannatum set the war to the credit of his name Anatum, and left behind the Amorite name Lumma, was his way of showing that Lagash could hold against all of this. The last layer was the matter of titles: the old kingship of Kish had fallen vacant in the late Early Dynastic period, and the inscription says that the goddess Inanna gave the kingship of Kish to Eannatum along with his rule of Lagash, so Eannatum styled himself King of Kish. For Lagash, winning the title of Kish and getting Ur and Nippur to acknowledge Lagash's overlordship again was an action that traded blood for political legitimacy, and the mythological scenes on the stele are the official version of that calculation.
impact: 這場戰爭留下的，是蘇美爾政治形態的一次轉折。恩納圖姆是第一個留下可核實征服記錄的蘇美爾城邦君主：他的銘文把征服埃蘭之地、征服烏瑪、征服烏爾並列寫下，意味著拉伽什不再只是眾城邦之一，而開始以領主自居，這條路子後來被薩爾貢的阿卡德帝國放大。禿鷹碑則是已知最早以歷史戰役為主題的王室紀念碑：它把國王的方陣、車戰與尼努爾塔的巨網並置在同一塊石頭上，讓戰爭第一次有了可以看、可以讀的官方版本，也讓「神把敵人收進網裡」成為往後數千年近東王權的標準修辭。另一層影響在水利與行政：恩納圖姆在尼娜挖渠蓄水、砌燒磚水井，刻在圓錐銘文上炫耀從迪爾蒙運來的船隻；城市型的國家不再只是收稅，而是開始投資水系。至於烏瑪，這場戰爭之後元氣大傷，洪水與內亂先後打擊城郊，烏瑪在王表上的位置一路下滑，到第三王朝的烏爾時代已經只剩一個小鎮。
impactEn: What this war left behind was a change in the political shape of Sumer. Eannatum is the first Sumerian city ruler whose conquests can be verified: his inscription sets the conquest of the land of Elam, of Umma and of Ur side by side, which means that Lagash had ceased to be one city among many and had begun to behave as an overlord; the line was later enlarged by Sargon of Akkad. The Stele of the Vultures is the earliest known royal monument with a historical battle as its subject: it sets the king's phalanx, the war wagons and Ninurta's great net side by side on one block of stone, giving war for the first time an official version that could be looked at and read, and fixing the image of a god gathering the enemy into a net as the standard rhetoric of Near Eastern kingship for thousands of years to come. A second effect lies in waterworks and administration: Eannatum cut canals and reservoirs at Nina, built a well of fired brick, and boasted on the cone inscription of the boats arriving from Dilmun; the city state was no longer only a tax collector but began to invest in its water system. As for Umma, the war left it badly weakened, with the flood and the internal rising hitting the countryside in turn; its position on the King List slid steadily downward until, in the Ur period of the Third Dynasty, it was no more than a small town.
result: 結果分三層。對烏瑪：拉伽什贏得了古埃丁平原，烏什兵敗身亡，烏瑪向拉伽什繳納穀物，銘文說每個人都要按份量向女神尼娜與神因古里薩的庫房交納；烏什死後，埃納卡列與恩納圖姆立下界約，把田界與界渠固定下來；再之後恩梅特納再度用兵，並把洪水淹掉烏瑪郊區說成自己的戰果，烏瑪此後再無力與拉伽什爭雄。對蘇美爾：烏爾、尼普爾、烏魯克、阿克沙克與基什先後承認拉伽什的宗主地位，馬里被寫成進貢的終點，恩納圖姆在銘文裡自稱基什之王，蘇美爾第一次出現一個跨越多城的實體。對埃蘭：銘文把征服埃蘭之地寫在首位，還記下奪取阿茲、掃擊舒布爾；拉伽什的軍隊曾深入埃蘭腹地，把蘇薩納入射程，但這次遠征並未把埃蘭變成行省。恩納圖姆在位期間各地叛起不斷，他死後基什重拾獨立，阿克沙克恢復，拉伽什的版圖很快退回蘇美爾南部，由恩梅特納與後人收拾。
resultEn: The outcome had three layers. For Umma: Lagash won the plain of Gu-Edin, Ush was defeated and killed, and Umma was made to pay grain to Lagash — the inscription says that every single person had to deliver a fixed measure into the treasury of the goddess Nina and the god Ingurisa. After Ush's death, Enakalle and Eannatum concluded a boundary agreement that fixed the field lines and the canals; later Enmetena took up arms again and claimed the flood that drowned the Umma countryside as his own victory, and Umma was never again able to contest Lagash's primacy. For Sumer: Ur, Nippur, Uruk, Akshak and Kish in turn acknowledged Lagash's overlordship, Mari was written in as the end of the tribute road, and Eannatum styled himself King of Kish in his inscriptions, so that for the first time a single entity straddled several Sumerian cities. For Elam: the inscription puts the conquest of the land of Elam first and also records the taking of Az and the striking of Shubur; the Lagash troops went deep into Elamite territory and brought Susa within reach, but the expedition did not turn Elam into a province. Revolt broke out in several parts of the empire during Eannatum's reign, and after his death Kish recovered its independence and Akshak came back to life; the Lagash dominion quickly shrank back into southern Sumer, to be tidied up by Enmetena and his successors.
